finding.text: At 400 the first session row starts at y≈535 of 1000: the usage block is three stacked meters (~95 px), the origin chips wrap to three rows (~110 px), and there is a ~50 px gap under the "AI" title. The approved page asks for "one usage line" and the plan for "two filter chips, one row", so on a phone half the screen goes to controls before the first session (Requirements 4, 10; Wrapping) — shots/…/400.png, bands 1–4; layout.json page-title y 72, ad-dash y 154.
There is no `requirements.md` in the task folder. This review used the owner's words quoted in `doc/ai-dashboard-plan.md` ("What you asked" and "The approved page") as the brief.
The diff commits five PNGs under `doc/ai-dashboard-plan/shots3/` and `shots4/`. They sit outside the ignored `ai/**/shots/` path, and `doc/repo-size.md` found screenshots are 84% of git history.
layout.json logs one 404 at each width. Nothing visible breaks, but the missing resource should be named or fixed.
Cost formats differ: `$0.212` / `$0.122` (three decimals) sit beside `$2.31` and `$646` (`SessionRow.usd`), so the cost column does not line up at a glance (shots/…/1200.png, Servex rows).

Every row always shows its second line (duration · model · agent). The plan shows that line only for a row that is open or working, so rows are twice as tall as the plan's phone sketch (shots/…/400.png).
The Voice rows show their own cost only, with no fold arrow and no rolled-up "$own · $tree" pair. Nesting and roll-up are visible only on "Connection test ▸ … 5 below · own $3.53" (shots/…/1200.png).
The plan still promises a `?debug` view of `SessionTree` ("Show the class"), and slice 1 has none.

At 400 the origin chips wrap to three rows (shots/127-0-0-1-51718-framework-ai/400.png, chip band, about 95 px), but `AIDashboard.css` sets `.ad-chips .ad-strip { flex-wrap: nowrap; overflow-x: auto }` under 46em. The shot also shows `$0.212` where `SessionRow.usd` gives two decimals (1200.png, "Worktree qf-4"). So either the shots were taken before the final code, or the nowrap rule loses. Re-shoot 400 to tell which.
There is no `requirements.md` in the task folder. The asks below come from the owner's words quoted in `doc/ai-dashboard-plan.md` ("What you asked" and "The approved page").

The diff commits seven PNGs under `doc/ai-dashboard-plan/shots3/`, `shots4/` and `shots5/`. `.gitignore` only covers `ai/**/shots/`, and `doc/repo-size.md` found screenshots are 84% of git history. Leave them out, or move them under an ignored `shots/` path.
layout.json `errors`: one 404 at each width. It does not show on the page, but it should be named or fixed (likely a missing `index.json` or asset).
The Scheduled chip's icon is a bare `·` ("· Scheduled 69 · $39.20"), which reads like a stray separator next to the other `·` separators (400.png, chip band). Give it a real icon.
At 400 there is a large gap under the "AI" title: the title band ends near y 112 and the dashboard starts at y 154 (layout.json bands), with about 40 px more above the usage meters in the shot.
The white "All" label on the `--prime` orange chip looks under 4.5:1 (400.png). Check the `--prime`/`--prime-ink` pair.
